item.title: California party chair calls for Democrats with no ‘viable path’ to drop out of governor race
item.description: A top Democratic Party leader is calling on some candidates to drop out of the race for California governor.

item.title: Two World Cup teams to train in San Diego
item.description: San Diego will be the base for Switzerland and New Zealand's World Cup teams.

item.title: Is Facebook down? Thousands report issues with platform
item.description: Thousands of Facebook users experienced issues with their accounts on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: 3-vehicle crash on I-5 near Carlsbad blocks several lanes
item.description: A three-vehicle crash on the I-5 southbound blocked several lanes and caused traffic delays late Tuesday morning, according to officials.

item.title: 41 Years of Service with San Diego County Sheriff Kelly Martinez
item.description: San Diego County Sheriff Kelly Martinez discusses her 41-year career in law enforcement, her dedication to serving the public, and her commitment to making the community safe.

item.title: Traffic delays expected near high-alert military bases in San Diego
item.description: Military bases in San Diego, including Naval Base San Diego, Marine Corps Recruit Depot San Diego, Naval Base Point Loma, Marine Corps Air Station Miramar, U.S. Coast Guard Sector San Diego, Naval Base Coronado, Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, and Marine Corps Air Station Miramar, remain on high alert for attacks due to rising conflict in the Middle East, with heightened security causing traffic delays in the area.

item.title: Chula Vista’s Bayside Park to receive facelift with nautical-themed playground, splash pad
item.description: The Port of San Diego and the City of Chula Vista broke ground on the Harbor Park Improvements Project, which will add new amenities and double the size of the park to 25 acres, with a budget of $15 million and a completion date of 2025.

item.title: San Marcos deputies use drone to locate suspect, stumble upon marijuana grow yard
item.description: A man was arrested in San Marcos on suspicion of theft and narcotics-related charges after deputies used a drone to locate him and discovered evidence of a marijuana grow in the yard of the home he had fled from.

item.title: US Navy sailors face felony charges for alleged Jamul house party attack
item.description: Nine U.S. Navy sailors and a former sailor are facing felony charges, including assault with a deadly weapon, in connection with a violent house party in Jamul that left three people seriously injured.

item.title: Semi truck crashes, bursts into flames on I-805 in San Diego
item.description: Morning traffic on the I-805 through Mission Valley is delayed due to a vehicle on fire in the southbound lanes.
